'''Obulette shipyards''' or '''Obulette dockyards''' were a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair facility in orbit around the planet [[Obulette]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. Obulette was the capital world of [[House Mecetti]].

==History==
The shipyards were open to all except [[House Melantha]] and [[House Pelagia]] vessels who were strictly forbidden from using the facility. All other [[Tapani Noble Houses|house]] affiliations were welcome, but the prices depended on political favor. These shipyards were an alternative to the [[Tallaani Shipyards|shipyards]] at [[Tallaan]]. Another major shipyard in the Tapani sector was the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] in the [[Freeworlds Territory]].
